《壮志凌云》这部电影讲述的是一位美国海军中尉麦德林的飞行故事，麦德林的父亲是美国一名功勋飞行员，也是麦德林的偶像。后来麦德林跟他的朋友古斯一起被选派到美国最严格的武器学校学习。
但是在军校的生活里，麦德林因为性格问题，训练非常不顺利。他在空中特立独行，队友常常无法跟他一起配合执行任务。
在课堂上，他有意对女教官进行刁难，以女教官陷入尴尬为乐。然而，麦德林后来却喜欢上了这名女教官。
毕业前的一次飞行训练中，麦德林和朋友古斯一同驾驶一架飞机，却不想发生了事故，麦德林得救，古斯因跳伞后撞击机体身亡。麦德林之后郁郁寡欢，教官用麦德林父亲的故事激励他，女教官查丽也过来鼓励他。因为麦德林无法振作，查丽痛心离去。
毕业飞行上，麦德林因为想到了古斯而成绩不佳。但是最终，麦德林走出了阴霾，找回自己，在赢得队友尊重的同时，也获得了女教官查丽的爱。
这是典型的挫折再到恢复勇气，找回自信的个人英雄主义叙事，《壮志凌云1》的票房超过三亿美元，还成为当时美国人民最受欢迎的电影。
刘济民将故事背景改编成六十年代中期，主角的名字改为陈长明，为抗美援朝功勋飞行员后代，兄弟的名字则是韩泽刚，两人均来自南方的海军航空兵部队。
建国以后，尤其是抗美援朝之后，我国空域并不安宁，岛上和美国的侦察机和战斗机入境是常有的事情。刚开始政策为“不开第一枪”，后来改为坚决打击。在空战中，我军多次击落美军的F-4战斗机、无人机及侦察机等。
陈长明和韩泽刚均来自沿海航空兵部队，常年驾驶歼五战斗机战斗在一线。
随着歼六战机逐渐列装部队，陈长明和韩泽刚受命进入第七航空学校，也就是长春航校学习。全军抽调的精英飞行员齐聚于此，不仅要学会歼六战机的驾驶，还组建了一个尖端小队——‘灭鹰’，探索出适合歼六的战法并飞出极限性能，从而更好地驾驶歼六战机，击落入侵的美军飞机。
在训练中，陈长明因为自身的性格不断受到战友指责，并且表现出逆反的情绪。在此期间，他结识了机械工程师郭思雅，两人相处起来磕磕绊绊，但独特的性格却引起了郭思雅的兴趣。
之后在一次飞行训练中，陈长明和韩泽刚两人驾驶歼教五在训练时，因为遇到大雾，加上新机操作不当、又发生故障，飞机坠毁，韩泽刚身亡。
丧失斗志的陈长明在教官和郭思雅的鼓励中，逐渐走出阴霾。航校毕业科目是空域巡航，当天，陈长明驾驶飞机在沿海上空巡逻，忽然遇到了入侵的美国机队——F4护送RA-3D侦察机入境侦查。
陈长明等四架歼六在指挥部的指挥下，成功击落F4和RA-3D侦察机。
陈长明用一场战斗走出心魔，落地后，赢得了战友的尊重。

The movie "Top Gun" tells the flight story of Medellin, a U.S. Navy lieutenant. Medellin's father is a meritorious pilot in the United States and is Medellin's idol. Later, Medellin and his friend Gus were selected to study at the most rigorous weapons school in the United States.
However, in the life of the military academy, Medellin's training was not smooth because of his personality problems. He is a maverick in the air, and his teammates often cannot cooperate with him to perform tasks.
In class, he deliberately made things difficult for the female instructors and took pleasure in embarrassing them. However, Medellin later fell in love with the female instructor.
During a flight training before graduation, Medellin and his friend Gus flew a plane together, but an accident occurred. Medellin was saved, but Gus died after parachuting and hitting the aircraft. Medellin was depressed afterwards. The instructor used the story of Medellin's father to encourage him, and the female instructor Charlie also came to encourage him. Because Medellin couldn't cheer up, Charlie left sadly.
On the graduation flight, Medellin failed in his grades because he thought about Gus. But in the end, Medellin came out of the gloom and found himself. While winning the respect of his teammates, he also won the love of female instructor Charlie.
This is a typical narrative of personal heroism from setback to regaining courage and regaining confidence. "Top Gun 1" grossed more than 300 million US dollars at the box office and became the most popular movie among the American people at that time.
Liu Jimin adapted the background of the story to the mid-1960s. The protagonist's name was changed to Chen Changming, a descendant of a meritorious pilot who fought against the United States and aided Korea. The brother's name was Han Zegang, both of whom came from the naval aviation unit in the south.
After the founding of the People's Republic of China, especially after the war to resist U.S. aggression and aid Korea, our country's airspace was not peaceful. It was common for reconnaissance planes and fighter jets from the island and the United States to enter the country. At the beginning, the policy was "not to fire the first shot", but later it was changed to resolute strike. In air battles, our army has repeatedly shot down US F-4 fighter jets, drones and reconnaissance aircraft.
Chen Changming and Han Zegang are both from the Coastal Aviation Force and have been flying J-5 fighter jets on the front line all year round.
As the J-6 fighter jets gradually entered the army, Chen Changming and Han Zegang were ordered to enter the Seventh Aviation School, which is the Changchun Aviation School. Elite pilots drawn from the entire military gathered here, not only to learn how to fly J-6 fighters, but also to form a cutting-edge team - the "Eagle Destroyer", to explore tactics suitable for J-6 and fly to the extreme performance, so as to better fly J-6 fighters and shoot down invading US aircraft.
During training, Chen Changming was constantly criticized by his comrades for his character and showed rebellious emotions. During this period, he met mechanical engineer Guo Siya. The two got along stumblingly, but their unique personality aroused Guo Siya's interest.
Later, during a flight training, Chen Changming and Han Zegang were flying the J-5. Due to heavy fog, improper operation of the new aircraft, and malfunctions, the plane crashed and Han Zegang died.
Chen Changming, who lost his fighting spirit, gradually came out of the gloom with the encouragement of the instructor and Guo Siya. The graduation subject of the aviation school was airspace patrol. On that day, Chen Changming was flying a plane to patrol over the coast, and suddenly encountered the invading American fleet - F4 escorting the RA-3D reconnaissance aircraft for inbound reconnaissance.
Under the command of the headquarters, Chen Changming and other four J-6s successfully shot down the F4 and RA-3D reconnaissance aircraft.
Chen Changming used a battle to get rid of his inner demons, and after landing, he won the respect of his comrades.
